full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 28
Daily Agenda
Federal
Nepal
Parliament,
Saturday, Ashad 14, 2083
11:00 AM
Letter from the Office of the President
The Honorable Speaker will read out the letter from the Office of the President regarding the certification of bills.
1. Presentation of Annual Report
On behalf of the Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, the Honorable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will present the "Report of the Auditor General, 2083".
2. Management Work
On behalf of the Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, the Honorable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will:
(a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) Introduce the "Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
3. The Honorable Minister of Finance Dr. Swarnim Wagle will:
(a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Money Laundering Prevention (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) Introduce the "Money Laundering Prevention (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
4. The Honorable Minister of Land Management, Cooperatives, Poverty Alleviation and National Planning Pratibha Rawal will:
(a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Cooperatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) Introduce the "Cooperatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
5. The Honorable Minister of Health and Population Nisha Mehta will:
(a) Present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Acts Related to Health Sciences Institute, 2083".
(b) Introduce the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Acts Related to Health Sciences Institute, 2083".
6. Discussion on the "Financial Bill, 2083" with amendments will be held.
7. Amendments to the "Financial Bill, 2083" will be presented for decision.
8. The Honorable Minister of Finance Dr. Swarnim Wagle will:
(a) Present a proposal that "The Financial Bill, 2083 be passed".
(b) Present a proposal that "Clause-by-clause discussion on the "National Debt Raising Bill, 2083" be held in the House".
Amendments to the "National Debt Raising Bill, 2083" will be presented for decision.
9. The Honorable Minister of Finance Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present a proposal that "The National Debt Raising Bill, 2083 be passed".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.summary_en: The Speaker will read a letter from the Office of the President regarding bill certification. This section sets the stage for the day's proceedings.

sections.name: Presentation of Annual Report
sections.summary_en: On behalf of the Prime Minister, the Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs will present the Auditor General's Annual Report for 2083.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: Several bills are proposed for introduction, including amendments to public procurement, money laundering prevention, cooperatives, and health sciences acts. The Financial Bill and National Debt Raising Bill are also scheduled for discussion and potential passage.
